comment: Type-check scope for the CDK app (bin + lib) only. This is the gap that
let PR #281's TS2339 reach main: `nest build` compiles the NestJS services,
jest doesn't load the CDK app, and `cdk synth` needs operator .env + Docker,
so no pre-merge gate compiled server/lib. `tsc -p tsconfig.json` can't be
used directly because it globs application/** specs + @react-pdf decls.
Lambda sources under lib/**/lambda/** are excluded: cdk resolves them by
string `entry` path and esbuild bundles them at synth — they are NOT in
the CDK app's tsc import graph, so type-checking them here would diverge
